name: Glasses
summary: Pair of clear-lens eyeglasses with rectangular frames in 3/4 view; for reading, vision and office scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the lens bottoms sit on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the lenses are about 440 px apart, hero size; use about 0.25 next to a person

params.name: color2
params.note: lens colour (keep it pale or clear)

params.name: anim
params.note: shine = a glint sweeps across the left lens; bob = the glasses bob gently
